name: All Employees in Health Care - U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, All Employees, Health Care [CES6562000101], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CES6562000101, August 28, 2025.
description: Monthly observations tracking the total number of employees in the health care sector in the United States, measured in thousands of persons. The data comes from the Current Employment Statistics (Establishment Survey) and is seasonally adjusted.
preprocessing: Load CES6562000101.csv; rename observation_date to timestamps (UTC).

Output CSV schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps (JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings), values (JSON array; NaN serialized as null via allow_nan=True). Timestamps are shared across variates in multivariate tasks (one row per variate).
